senses.en: An electronic machine that stores and processes information using programs.

ex.en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
Access to a computer at home can help students complete assignments and develop essential digital skills.

col: computer skills｜kỹ năng sử dụng máy tính
tip: Làm việc trên máy tính dùng work on a computer.

senses.en: The activity of looking for and buying things.
The things you have bought during a shopping trip.

ex.en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.

col: do the shopping｜đi chợ; mua đồ dùng hằng ngày
tip: shopping là danh từ không đếm được; “đi mua sắm” dùng go shopping.

senses.en: the complete set of letters used in a language

ex.en: My little sister learned the alphabet through a song.

col: the English alphabet｜bảng chữ cái tiếng Anh
learn the alphabet｜học bảng chữ cái
alphabet song｜bài hát bảng chữ cái
tip: alphabet chỉ cả bộ chữ cái; một chữ cái riêng lẻ là letter.

senses.en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found.
To give attention to a problem and try to solve it.

senses.zh: phát biểu trước; diễn thuyết với
senses.en: To speak directly to a person or group.

address an audience｜phát biểu trước khán giả

senses.en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize.
To gain something through effort or personal qualities.
A successful result in a competition or contest.

col: win a match｜thắng một trận đấu
win support｜giành được sự ủng hộ
win someone's trust｜chiếm được lòng tin của ai
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là won; thắng trận dùng win, đánh bại ai dùng beat.

senses.zh: lớn lên; tăng trưởng; phát triển

To gradually become different in condition or feeling.

ex.en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.

col: grow increasingly concerned｜ngày càng lo lắng

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box
to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.

col: a box of chocolates｜một hộp sô-cô-la
tip: Số nhiều là boxes; a box of theo sau là thứ đựng trong hộp.

senses.en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience.
Enjoyable and entertaining.

ex.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.

tip: fun là danh từ không đếm được; funny thường nghĩa là buồn cười hoặc kỳ lạ.

senses.en: Hair growing on a person's chin and cheeks.

ex.en: He trimmed his beard before leaving for work.
In some workplaces, employees with beards must use special coverings to maintain food hygiene standards.

tip: beard chỉ râu ở cằm và hai bên má; moustache là ria mép.

senses.en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid
Having rain or frequent rainfall
To put water or another liquid onto something

col: wet the cloth｜làm ướt miếng vải

senses.en: What people use to pay for goods and services.
The wealth that a person or organisation owns.

ex.en: I saved enough money to buy a new bicycle.
Governments should invest more money in public transport to reduce congestion and improve air quality.

tip: Thường không đếm được: nói much money, không nói many money.

senses.en: Have the same opinion or accept someone else's view
Decide something together or promise to do something

ex.en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.

agree on a plan｜thống nhất kế hoạch
agree to do something｜đồng ý làm gì
agree to a proposal｜chấp thuận một đề xuất
tip: Đồng ý với ai dùng with; thống nhất về điều gì dùng on; nhận lời làm gì dùng to do.

senses.en: at the present time
immediately, without waiting
because a situation has changed or become true

col: from now on｜từ giờ trở đi

senses.en: existing in fact rather than being imagined
genuine rather than copied or artificial

senses.zh: thực tế; (đã) điều chỉnh theo lạm phát
senses.en: measured after allowing for changes in prices

ex.en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.

senses.en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated

ex.en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.

col: someone to talk to｜người để tâm sự

senses.en: notice a sound through your ears
receive information about something
listen formally to evidence or arguments

Local councils should hear residents' concerns before making decisions about major changes to public transport.

hear about something｜nghe nói về điều gì
hear a case｜xét xử một vụ án
hear both sides｜nghe cả hai bên

senses.en: Used to make a request or offer more polite.

senses.zh: làm hài lòng; làm vui lòng
senses.en: To make someone feel happy or satisfied.

col: please everyone｜làm hài lòng mọi người

senses.en: Firm and not easily bent, cut, or pressed
Requiring considerable effort or being difficult to endure
With great effort, force, or intensity

Many students work hard to gain qualifications, yet still find it difficult to secure stable employment.

tip: hard có thể là trạng từ nghĩa “chăm chỉ”; hardly nghĩa là “hầu như không”.

senses.en: Very bad or unpleasant.
Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.

ex.en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.

col: a terrible mistake｜một sai lầm nghiêm trọng
feel terrible｜cảm thấy rất khó chịu
tip: terrible là tính từ; muốn nói “rất” thường dùng trạng từ terribly.

senses.en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief.
Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position.

senses.zh: cảm giác khi chạm; không khí
senses.en: The quality something has when touched or experienced.

Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.

col: feel strongly about｜có quan điểm mạnh mẽ về
feel like doing something｜muốn làm gì
get a feel for｜dần nắm bắt được
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là felt; sau feel có thể dùng trực tiếp tính từ.

senses.en: An object that children use for play.
To handle casually or consider without serious commitment.

ex.en: The baby dropped her toy behind the sofa.
Well-designed toys can encourage young children to develop practical skills through creative play and exploration.

col: toy with an idea｜cân nhắc qua loa một ý tưởng

senses.en: to such a degree or extent
used to introduce a result or consequence
used instead of repeating an idea already mentioned

Public transport is limited in rural areas, so many residents rely on private cars for essential journeys.

tip: so bổ nghĩa cho tính từ hoặc trạng từ; such thường bổ nghĩa cho cụm danh từ.

senses.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands
to increase in amount or level
an act of moving upwards or an increase in level

ex.en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.

col: a steep climb｜một đoạn leo dốc
tip: Chữ b ở cuối không đọc; climb a mountain không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs

ex.en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
Protecting native bird species requires preserving their habitats and reducing pollution in both rural and urban areas.

col: a flock of birds｜một đàn chim
a bird of prey｜chim săn mồi
tip: Đàn chim dùng a flock of birds; bird là danh từ đếm được.

senses.en: an activity or contest played according to rules
wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat
willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar

ex.en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.

col: team game｜môn thể thao đồng đội

senses.en: Only one, rather than several or many.
Not married or not in a romantic relationship.

ex.en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.

col: a single person｜một người; người độc thân

senses.en: An open area with grass and trees for public enjoyment.

senses.zh: khu (dành cho hoạt động cụ thể)
senses.en: An area set aside for a particular activity or purpose.

ex.en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.

tip: Công viên là park; trong Anh-Anh bãi đỗ xe là car park.

senses.en: a male child or young male person

ex.en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.

col: a baby boy｜bé trai sơ sinh
tip: Thường chỉ nam chưa trưởng thành; gọi người đàn ông trưởng thành là boy có thể bất lịch sự.

senses.en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat.
Meat from a chicken, eaten as food.

ex.en: The chickens scratched the soil beside our vegetable patch.
Replacing some red meat with chicken can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.

tip: Gà còn sống là danh từ đếm được, thịt gà là không đếm được; gà con thường dùng chick.

senses.en: A white liquid female mammals produce to feed their young.
Take milk from an animal, especially a cow.

ex.en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.

col: a glass of milk｜một cốc sữa
tip: milk thường không đếm được; nói a glass of milk, không nói a milk.

senses.en: Connects words or statements that belong together.
Connects an action with what follows or results from it.

ex.en: I bought fresh bread and cheese for our picnic.
Governments should invest in public transport and encourage cycling to reduce congestion in growing cities.

col: again and again｜hết lần này đến lần khác

senses.en: the majority of something, or the greatest amount or number
the majority or greatest part of a group or amount
to the greatest degree; sometimes used to mean very

ex.en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
Most urban residents would benefit from reliable public transport that connects residential areas with major employment centres.

col: most of the time｜phần lớn thời gian
tip: Nói chung chung dùng most people; nói cụ thể dùng most of the people.

a report about an event in the news
one level of a building, in American English

Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.

tip: Tầng nhà Anh-Anh viết storey, Anh-Mỹ viết story; chiều cao không cố định.

senses.en: Different from or additional to those already mentioned.

Schools should teach practical skills alongside other subjects to prepare students for the demands of adult life.

tip: other đi với danh từ; others đứng độc lập; cái còn lại trong hai cái là the other.

senses.en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin

ex.en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.

tip: Danh từ đếm được; “một quả táo” dùng an apple.

senses.zh: thuộc Trung Quốc; thuộc tiếng Trung

The group of languages spoken in China, especially Mandarin.
People who come from China.

ex.en: We shared Chinese dumplings at a small restaurant yesterday.
Learning Chinese can help international students develop a deeper understanding of cultural traditions in China.

tip: Luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; chỉ một người Trung Quốc thường dùng a Chinese person.

senses.en: The mixture of gases surrounding Earth that people breathe.
A particular quality that someone or something seems to have.

senses.zh: thông gió; bày tỏ công khai
senses.en: To let fresh air in, or express views publicly.

air concerns｜công khai bày tỏ mối lo ngại
tip: Khi nghĩa là không khí thì không đếm được; an air of nghĩa là “vẻ ... (một phẩm chất nào đó)”.

ex.en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.

col: because of the weather｜do thời tiết

senses.en: a group working together or playing a sport together
to join someone to work together, usually with up

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.

tip: Trong Anh-Anh, team có thể đi với động từ số ít hoặc số nhiều.

senses.en: Correct, true, or suitable for a particular purpose.
Something you are legally or morally entitled to.
On the side opposite to the left.

the right to education｜quyền được giáo dục
make the right decision｜đưa ra quyết định đúng đắn

senses.en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand.
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

senses.en: A tool with a solid core for writing or drawing.

senses.zh: viết hoặc vẽ bằng bút chì
senses.en: To write or draw something with a pencil.

ex.en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.

tip: Viết bằng bút chì nói in pencil; pencil in nghĩa là tạm thời sắp xếp.

senses.en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated

ex.en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.

col: somebody to talk to｜người để tâm sự
tip: Làm chủ ngữ thì động từ dùng số ít; thường dùng they để thay thế ở câu sau.

senses.en: an individual human being
a grammatical category distinguishing speakers, listeners, and others

ex.en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.

tip: Số nhiều thông thường là people; persons thường gặp trong văn bản pháp lý trang trọng.

senses.en: a public road in a town, usually lined with buildings

ex.en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.

tip: street thường chỉ đường trong thị trấn có nhà hai bên.

senses.en: have someone or something as part of a whole
make someone or something part of a group or activity

ex.en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
Urban development plans should include affordable housing and reliable public transport to support low-income residents.

col: include someone in｜cho ai tham gia
include a range of｜bao gồm một loạt
tip: include thường chỉ liệt kê một phần, không có nghĩa là danh sách đầy đủ.

senses.en: a device used to receive and play broadcast sound

senses.zh: phát thanh; liên lạc vô tuyến
senses.en: broadcasting or communication using electromagnetic waves

senses.zh: liên lạc hoặc truyền tin bằng vô tuyến
senses.en: to contact someone or send information using radio equipment

ex.en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
Radio remains an important source of information in remote communities where reliable internet access is limited.

tip: Nghe đài thường nói listen to the radio; trên đài dùng on the radio.

senses.en: a place where people send mail and buy stamps

ex.en: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.

col: local post office｜bưu điện địa phương
post office counter｜quầy giao dịch bưu điện
post office branch｜chi nhánh bưu điện

note: Đã sửa cách viết có gạch nối không chuẩn thành post office.

senses.en: water that has frozen solid
to cover a cake or biscuit with icing

ex.en: She dropped a few cubes of ice into her juice.

col: ice a cake｜phủ đường lên bánh
tip: ice chỉ băng thì thường không đếm được; một viên đá là an ice cube.

senses.en: The part of the day between afternoon and bedtime.

ex.en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.

tip: Nói chung chung dùng in the evening; this evening không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: All things or all the things in a particular situation.
The most important thing in someone's life or situation.

Although digital resources are valuable, students should not assume that everything they read online is accurate.

col: mean everything to someone｜có ý nghĩa vô cùng với ai

senses.zh: phía tây; hướng tây; miền tây
senses.en: the direction where the sun sets, opposite east

senses.zh: thuộc phía tây; hướng về phía tây
senses.en: in or facing the direction where the sun sets

senses.zh: về phía tây; ở phía tây
senses.en: towards or in the west

Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.

tip: Phương hướng thường viết thường; the West chỉ các nước phương Tây thì viết hoa.

senses.zh: anh trai; em trai; anh/em ruột
senses.en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.

Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.

senses.en: a very high area of land with steep sides
a very large amount of something

Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.

col: a mountain of work｜một núi công việc
tip: Một ngọn núi là mountain; dãy núi thường dùng mountain range.

senses.en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison
used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison

Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.

tip: than dùng để so sánh; then nghĩa là “sau đó”, chú ý chính tả.

senses.en: having a comfortable temperature that is not hot
showing kindness, friendliness, or affection
to become warmer or make something warmer

A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.

warm to someone｜dần có thiện cảm với ai

senses.en: The time ahead, or what will happen to someone or something.

Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.

col: future generations｜các thế hệ mai sau

senses.en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language
a person from Germany
the language spoken in Germany and some neighbouring countries

ex.en: We shared a traditional German cake after dinner.
German universities attract international students through research opportunities and a wide range of degree programmes.

col: a German citizen｜một công dân Đức
tip: Luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; khi chỉ ngôn ngữ thường không dùng mạo từ.

senses.en: the whole amount of something or every member of a group

senses.zh: tất cả; mọi người, mọi vật
senses.en: everything or everyone in a particular group
completely or entirely

ex.en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.

col: all of us｜tất cả chúng tôi
tip: all đi với danh từ số nhiều hoặc không đếm được; every đi với danh từ đếm được số ít.

senses.en: Move towards the speaker or a particular place.
Arrive in time or happen.
Have a particular origin or source.

ex.en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
Much of the funding for public libraries comes from local government rather than private donations.

tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: come - came - come; come from nghĩa là đến từ.

senses.en: To put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow

ex.en: We usually eat breakfast together before leaving the house.
Schools can encourage children to eat more vegetables by providing affordable meals with a variety of fresh ingredients.

col: eat a balanced diet｜ăn uống cân bằng
tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: eat - ate - eaten.

senses.en: A long, usually orange root vegetable.

senses.zh: mồi nhử; phần thưởng khuyến khích
senses.en: A reward offered to encourage someone to do something.

ex.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.

col: carrot and stick｜vừa thưởng vừa phạt
tip: Nghĩa bóng là phần thưởng hay mồi nhử; carrot and stick nghĩa là vừa thưởng vừa phạt.

senses.en: close to a place, time, or state
at or towards a short distance away in space or time
not far away in distance or time

ex.en: We found a quiet café near the station.
Building affordable housing near public transport can reduce commuting costs and improve access to employment.

col: in the near future｜trong tương lai gần
tip: near có thể đi thẳng với địa điểm; nearly thường nghĩa là “gần như”.

senses.en: a person's mother or father
a company that owns or controls another company
to raise and care for a child as a parent

ex.en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.

col: parent involvement｜sự tham gia của phụ huynh
tip: parent chỉ một trong hai người; parents thường chỉ cả cha và mẹ.

senses.en: Known by many people.

ex.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.

col: famous as｜nổi tiếng với tư cách là
tip: famous for theo sau là lý do nổi tiếng; famous as theo sau là thân phận.

senses.en: Only; no more than a particular amount or thing.
Very recently, or exactly at a particular point or degree.
Fair and morally right.

ex.en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.

col: a just society｜một xã hội công bằng
tip: Làm trạng từ có nghĩa “chỉ”, “vừa mới”; làm tính từ có nghĩa “công bằng”.

senses.en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.

ex.en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.

col: celebrate a birthday｜tổ chức sinh nhật
tip: Vào đúng ngày sinh nhật của ai thì dùng on, không dùng in hay at.

senses.en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food
to spread butter on food

ex.en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.

col: a knob of butter｜một cục bơ nhỏ
butter toast｜phết bơ lên bánh mì nướng
tip: butter là bơ (làm từ sữa), cream là kem sữa; tên thực phẩm này thường không đếm được.

senses.zh: trường cao đẳng; trường đại học
senses.en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses.

senses.zh: trường thành viên của đại học
senses.en: A constituent institution or division within a university.

ex.en: My cousin is studying nursing at a local college.
Making college education more affordable could improve social mobility and provide employers with a more skilled workforce.

col: go to college｜học đại học hoặc cao đẳng
tip: Anh-Mỹ thường dùng để chỉ chung đại học; Anh-Anh thường chỉ trường cao đẳng hoặc cơ sở giáo dục tiếp tục.

senses.en: Shut something or bring an activity to an end
Near in distance or connected by a strong personal relationship
At a short distance from someone or something

ex.en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
When local libraries close, residents lose valuable spaces for independent learning and community activities.

col: a close friend｜một người bạn thân
tip: Động từ đọc với âm /z/; tính từ và trạng từ đọc với âm /s/.

senses.en: away from a place or position

senses.zh: rời khỏi; không còn chạm vào
senses.en: away from or no longer touching something
not operating or not working at a particular time

ex.en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.

tip: off nhấn mạnh sự rời đi hoặc tắt; of thường chỉ sự sở thuộc, đừng nhầm hai từ.

senses.en: To let time pass until something happens or someone arrives.
To be left until a later time.

senses.zh: sự chờ đợi; thời gian chờ
senses.en: A period spent expecting something to happen.

ex.en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.

col: a long wait｜một lần chờ dài
tip: Chờ ai dùng wait for someone; chờ để làm gì dùng wait to do.

senses.en: in or into a position below something
less than a particular amount, age, or level

senses.zh: trong tình trạng; dưới sự kiểm soát của
senses.en: experiencing a condition or being controlled by someone or something

ex.en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.

col: under the age of｜dưới độ tuổi
tip: under có thể chỉ vị trí, số lượng hoặc tình trạng: under pressure.

senses.en: Relating to Italy, its people, culture, or language
The main language spoken in Italy
A person from Italy

ex.en: We cooked Italian pasta with tomatoes and fresh basil.
Studying Italian architecture can help students understand how historical buildings influence contemporary urban design.

tip: Tên quốc tịch và ngôn ngữ viết hoa chữ cái đầu; số nhiều của người Ý là Italians.

senses.en: Touching and supported by a surface.
Used for days and dates, or to introduce a topic.
Operating or receiving power.

ex.en: Your keys are on the table beside the door.
Installing solar panels on public buildings can reduce energy costs and demonstrate a government's commitment to sustainability.

col: a report on education｜một báo cáo về giáo dục
tip: Ngày cụ thể dùng on; tháng dùng in; giờ giấc dùng at.

senses.en: Belonging or relating to one particular person.
Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters.

senses.zh: mang tính cá nhân; công kích cá nhân
senses.en: Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.

tip: personal là thuộc cá nhân; personnel là toàn thể nhân viên, chú ý chính tả.

senses.en: able to happen, exist, or be done
worth considering as a choice or explanation

ex.en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.

col: as soon as possible｜càng sớm càng tốt
possible explanation｜lời giải thích khả dĩ
make it possible｜làm cho điều đó trở nên khả thi
tip: Thường dùng it is possible to do; không nói người + is possible to do.

senses.en: a monetary unit worth one hundredth of a dollar or euro
a coin worth one cent

ex.en: I found a cent under the sofa cushion.
For households with limited incomes, every cent saved on essential goods can contribute to greater financial security.

col: a fifty-cent coin｜đồng xu năm mươi xu
tip: cent là danh từ đếm được; số tiền lớn hơn một xu dùng cents.

senses.en: to explain what someone or something is like

ex.en: Can you describe the bag you left on the bus?
The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.

col: describe something in detail｜mô tả chi tiết điều gì
describe something as｜mô tả điều gì là
describe a process｜mô tả một quy trình
tip: Nói describe something to someone, không nói describe someone something.

senses.en: To express something using words.
To give information in writing or through other evidence.
The opportunity to influence a decision.

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.

col: say something to someone｜nói điều gì với ai
have a say in｜có tiếng nói trong
tip: Nói điều gì dùng say something; bảo ai dùng tell someone.

senses.en: a large amount or number, in a lot or lots
very much or often, in the phrase a lot
an area of land used for a particular purpose

ex.en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
Cities can save a lot of energy by improving public transport and encouraging residents to walk.

col: a lot of time｜nhiều thời gian
tip: a lot of đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều hoặc không đếm được; a lot có thể bổ nghĩa cho động từ.

senses.en: The father of your mother or father.

ex.en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.

tip: Không phân biệt bên nội hay ngoại; muốn nói ông ngoại có thể dùng maternal grandfather.

senses.en: loved or valued very much
costing a lot of money
used to express surprise, worry, or disappointment

ex.en: This little garden is very dear to my grandmother.
Places that are dear to local residents deserve consideration when urban redevelopment plans are prepared.

col: a dear friend｜một người bạn thân thiết
dear to someone｜được ai yêu quý
tip: dear nghĩa “đắt” chủ yếu dùng trong khẩu ngữ Anh-Anh; Dear thường dùng làm lời xưng hô đầu thư.

senses.en: feeling regret about something you did or something that happened
feeling sadness or sympathy because of someone's difficulties

ex.en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.

col: sorry for being late｜xin lỗi vì đến muộn
sorry about the mistake｜xin lỗi về sai sót
feel sorry for someone｜thấy tiếc cho ai
sorry to hear that｜rất tiếc khi nghe tin đó
tip: sorry for doing dùng để xin lỗi vì điều mình đã làm.

senses.en: One of the organs on your head used for hearing.

senses.zh: khả năng phân biệt âm thanh; thính giác
senses.en: The ability to recognise and distinguish sounds.
The grain-bearing part of a cereal plant, such as wheat.

ex.en: My ears felt cold, so I pulled on a hat.
Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.

col: an ear for music｜tai nhạy về âm nhạc
an ear of wheat｜một bông lúa mì
tip: have an ear for nghĩa là có khả năng nghe tốt về âm nhạc, ngôn ngữ...

senses.en: physically well and not suffering from illness
helping to maintain or improve health
successful, strong, or developing in a positive way

ex.en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.

col: a healthy diet｜chế độ ăn lành mạnh
a healthy lifestyle｜lối sống lành mạnh
a healthy economy｜nền kinh tế phát triển
tip: Vừa nói người khỏe mạnh, vừa nói chế độ ăn,... có lợi cho sức khỏe.

senses.en: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness.
The sound or act of expressing amusement.

ex.en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.

col: laugh at a joke｜bật cười vì câu chuyện cười
tip: laugh at someone thường nghĩa là cười nhạo; laugh with someone nghĩa là cùng cười với họ.

senses.en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for.
To have a particular opinion or experience of something.
Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.

ex.en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.

col: find a solution｜tìm ra giải pháp
find it difficult to｜thấy khó làm gì
a valuable find｜một phát hiện có giá trị
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là found; cấu trúc find + tân ngữ + tính từ.

senses.en: to give something to someone in exchange for money
to be bought in a particular quantity or way
to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.

col: sell something to someone｜bán cái gì cho ai
sell an idea｜quảng bá một ý tưởng
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là sold; sell well thường dùng ở dạng chủ động.

senses.en: To move on foot at a pace slower than running

senses.zh: cuộc đi dạo; quãng đường đi bộ
senses.en: A journey made on foot, often for pleasure

ex.en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.

col: walk to school｜đi bộ đến trường
walk the dog｜dắt chó đi dạo
tip: Chữ l không đọc; walk the dog nghĩa là dắt chó đi dạo.

senses.zh: với tư cách là; như là
senses.en: used to indicate someone's role or something's purpose
introduces a time, reason, or way something happens
used in comparisons to show an equal degree

ex.en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
As public transport becomes more reliable, fewer commuters may choose to drive to work.

col: as well as｜cũng như; ngoài ra còn
tip: as chỉ thân phận thực sự; like chỉ sự giống nhau. Khi nhấn mạnh đọc /æz/.

senses.en: move quickly on foot, lifting both feet between steps
manage a business, organisation, or activity
operate, or make a machine or program operate

ex.en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.

col: run a business｜điều hành doanh nghiệp
run a programme｜triển khai một chương trình
tip: Quá khứ ran, quá khứ phân từ run; hiện tại phân từ running.

senses.en: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it
not heavy, bright, or pale in colour
make something burn or provide brightness

ex.en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.

tip: Ánh sáng nói chung không đếm được; một cái đèn là a light; quá khứ của động từ thường là lit.

senses.en: direct your eyes towards someone or something
appear to have a particular quality or condition

senses.zh: cái nhìn; vẻ mặt; vẻ bề ngoài
senses.en: an act of looking, or someone's expression or appearance

ex.en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.

col: take a look｜nhìn qua một chút
tip: look at theo sau là vật được nhìn; look làm động từ nối thì theo sau là tính từ.

senses.en: coming before all others in order or time

senses.zh: trước hết; đầu tiên; trước tiên
senses.en: before anything or anyone else

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.

tip: at first nghĩa là lúc đầu; first có thể dùng để nêu ý thứ nhất.

senses.en: costing a large amount of money

ex.en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.

col: expensive to maintain｜tốn kém để bảo trì
an expensive mistake｜một sai lầm đắt giá
tip: Nói đồ vật đắt dùng expensive; nói giá cao dùng high.

senses.en: a system of words or gestures used for communication
the words and style used in a particular context

ex.en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.

tip: Chỉ một thứ tiếng cụ thể thì đếm được; chỉ khả năng ngôn ngữ nói chung thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied.
Full of people, traffic, or activity.
Already being used, especially a telephone line.

ex.en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.

col: a busy street｜một con phố nhộn nhịp
a busy schedule｜lịch trình dày đặc
tip: Dùng busy doing hoặc busy with, không dùng busy to do.

senses.en: To form words on paper or a screen.
To create a story, article, or piece of music.
To send someone a letter or written message.

ex.en: Please write your address on this small card.
Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.

col: write to someone｜viết thư cho ai
tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: write - wrote - written.

senses.en: the language spoken in Spain and many Latin American countries

senses.zh: thuộc Tây Ban Nha; thuộc tiếng Tây Ban Nha
senses.en: relating to Spain, its people, culture, or language

ex.en: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
Learning Spanish can broaden students' access to literature and improve their opportunities for international employment.

col: speak Spanish｜nói tiếng Tây Ban Nha
Spanish culture｜văn hóa Tây Ban Nha
Spanish-speaking countries｜các nước nói tiếng Tây Ban Nha
tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; một người Tây Ban Nha có thể nói a Spanish person.
